definitions.explanation: Fish that live in rivers, lakes, and other freshwater bodies, as opposed to those in the sea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鯉|こい}→鯉：02209_koi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{淡水魚|たんすいぎょ}だ。
⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧や⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧{淡水魚|たんすいぎょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: I researched freshwater fish that live in rivers and lakes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近年|きんねん}→近年：14349_kinnen⟧、⟦{外来|がいらい}→外来：09895_gairai⟧{淡水魚|たんすいぎょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{在来|ざいらい}⟦{種|しゅ}→種：28584_shu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脅|おびや}かしている→脅かす：13942_obiyakasu⟧。
examples.english: In recent years, non-native freshwater fish have been threatening native species.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{淡水|たんすい}→淡水：04508_tansui⟧ (fresh water) + {魚|ぎょ} (fish). Contrasted with {海水魚|かいすいぎょ} (saltwater fish).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {淡水魚|たんすいぎょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飼育|しいく}→飼育：06422_shiiku⟧: keeping freshwater fish (in an aquarium)
- {淡水魚|たんすいぎょ}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: freshwater-fish cuisine
- {在来|ざいらい}{淡水魚|たんすいぎょ}: native freshwater fish

COMMON EXAMPLES:
- ⟦{鯉|こい}→鯉：02209_koi⟧ (carp), ⟦{鮒|ふな}→鮒：26341_funa⟧ (crucian carp), {鮎|あゆ} (sweetfish), ⟦{鰻|うなぎ}→鰻：06105_unagi⟧ (eel), {岩魚|いわな} (char)

SIMILAR / CONTRASTING WORDS:
- {海水魚|かいすいぎょ}: saltwater fish
- {汽水魚|きすいぎょ}: brackish-water fish — lives where fresh and salt water mix
